name: 26588-prefillheavy-gemma426ba4b-1gpu
model: google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it, BF16, unquantized, ungated. ~51.6 GB in two safetensors shards, and it fits one card at this topology.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1 -- 51.6 GB of BF16 weights fit one 80 GB card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 20%, bounded at 600 requests with a 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix structure, seed 42. Prompts a fixed 1024 tokens, generations a fixed 256 tokens, `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`.
purpose: A document summarization assistant for 64 concurrent users, turning page-long inputs into short summaries on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang server arguments. Flat `key: value` only -- an indented line is skipped on read, so a
# nested block would be DROPPED and the engine would start without something this file declares.

model-path: google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: triton

# 1024 prompt + 256 generated = 1280 tokens in flight, capped just above that rather than left at
# the checkpoint's 262144, so the token-to-request pool is sized for the workload.
context-length: 2048

random-seed: 42
